data.name: A Helping Hand
data.description: Complete 50 favors at the seasonal altar.

data.name: Adept
data.description: Your journey continues as you grow in strength. Reach level 25 and become a true adept.

data.name: Alchemist
data.description: From vial to flask to splash: brew small health potions, minor health potions, and health splash potions to prove your mastery of the healing arts.

data.name: Amateur Lumberjack
data.description: Ash wood is the first step to mastery. Gather 6 000 ash woods and begin your lumberjack career.

data.name: Arachnophobia Conquered
data.description: Face your fears and clear the webs! Defeat 1 000 spiders to conquer your arachnophobia.

data.name: Bite! Oh, algae!
data.description: Sometimes, all you catch is algae. Gather 2 500 algaes and embrace the surprises of fishing.

data.name: Blood of the Cursed
data.description: In his house, Rosenblood awaits challengers. End the curse by defeating Rosenblood.

data.name: Cabinet Maker
data.description: Master cabinetry requires variety: craft hardwood, spruce, and dead wood planks to prove your woodworking expertise.

data.name: Clean the lab
data.description: Defeat 100 Cultist Alchemist to secure the house and unlock access to the Rosenblood.

data.name: Crafted with Honor
data.description: A Masterful Necklace is the mark of a true artisan. Craft one and wear your honor.

data.name: Cult Destroyer
data.description: The Cult Emperor weaves dark rituals, threatening the realm. End his blasphemous reign by defeating the Cult Emperor.

data.name: Diamond In The Sky
data.description: Diamonds are forever. Craft 2 diamonds and cherish your treasures.

data.name: Ecologist
data.description: The world breathes easier thanks to your efforts. Recycle 1 000 items.

data.name: Expert Fisherman
data.description: The elusive bass is the pride of expert anglers. Gather 6 000 bass.

data.name: Expert Lumberjack
data.description: Dead wood holds secrets of the forest. Gather 6 000 dead woods and prove your expertise.

data.name: Expert Miner
data.description: Gold is the prize of experts. Gather 6 000 gold ores and shine above the rest.

data.name: Feather Me Impressed
data.description: The legend of the endless flock beckons. Prove your might (and appetite) by slaughtering 1 000 chickens.

data.name: Fisherman
data.description: Shrimp swarm the shallows. Gather 6 000 shrimps and prove your skill as a fisherman.

data.name: Highway Patrol
data.description: No traveler is safe while highwaymen lurk. Patrol the roads and defeat 1 000 Highwaymen.

data.name: I want bacon!
data.description: The farms overflow with squealing pigs. Satisfy your hunger for glory (and bacon) by slaughtering 1 000 pigs.

data.name: In every color
data.description: Slimes splash every hue across the forest. Hunt 50 of each color to restore the forest's balance.

data.name: Intermediate Fisherman
data.description: The swift trout challenges all but the best. Gather 6 000 trouts and rise in the ranks.

data.name: Intermediate Lumberjack
data.description: Birch trees test your skill. Gather 6 000 birch woods to master your craft.

data.name: Intermediate Miner
data.description: Coal fuels progress. Gather 6 000 coals and power the world.

data.name: King of the Forest
data.description: The forest crowns those who master its hunters. Fell wolves, flying snakes, and mushmush to claim the title of King of the Forest.

data.name: King of the Goblins
data.description: Assert your dominance over the goblin tribes. Collect the required goblin and wolfrider trophies.

data.name: Lich Please!
data.description: The ancient Lich rules the dead lands, defying the living. Challenge fate and defeat the Lich to restore balance.

data.name: Life Lover
data.description: The shards of life are rare and precious. Prove your devotion by dropping 24 Life Crystal Shards.

data.name: Lumberjack
data.description: Spruce forests echo with the sound of axes. Gather 6 000 spruce woods and earn the title of Lumberjack.

data.name: Miner
data.description: Iron shapes kingdoms. Gather 6 000 iron ores to build your legacy.

data.name: Novice
data.description: Every hero starts somewhere. Reach level 10 and step onto the path of adventure.

data.name: Pearl Fisher
data.description: Small pearls shimmer in the deep. Gather 500 Small Pearls and become a true pearl fisher.

data.name: Professional Fisherman
data.description: Salmon run strong in wild rivers. Gather 6 000 salmons and become a professional fisherman.

data.name: Professional Lumberjack
data.description: Maple wood is the true professional’s choice. Gather 6,000 maple woods.

data.name: Professional Miner
data.description: Mithril ore is the dream of miners. Gather 6 000 mithril ores and reach professional status.

data.name: Secure the island
data.description: Defeat 50 Sea Marauders to secure the island, earn the villagers trust, and unlock access to the bank.

data.name: Slimed to None
data.description: A monstrous slime crowned in the forest. Prove your worth by defeating the King Slime.

data.name: Take her down!
data.description: The Goblin Priestess commands the forest's raiders. End her reign by defeating her in battle.

data.name: Tanner's Exchange
data.description: The tailor offers a precious trade: exchange your hides for fine leather. Buy 25 Hard Leather and 25 Snakeskin to the tailor.

data.name: Tasks Farmer
data.description: Complete 100 tasks and show your diligence to the people of the realm.

data.name: The New Bandit
data.description: Claim the mantle of the forest's outlaws. Kill 100 Bandit Lizards and show your new allegiance.

data.name: The Reaper
data.description: You walk the path of inevitable death. Slay 250 Skeletons, 250 Vampires, and 250 Death Knights.

data.name: Turning Treasures to Gold
data.description: Every treasure has its price. Sell 5 Golden Eggs and 5 Golden Shrimps.

data.name: Worker
data.description: From raw ore to refined metal: forge iron bars, steel bars, and gold bars to prove your worth as a skilled worker.
